how: Captured live by running that command with GH_TOKEN set to an invalid token, and copied verbatim. Not hand-written: a hand-written envelope of an external CLI proves the belief rather than the behaviour.
note: The condition this stands in for in CI is an admin-permission 403, which could not be produced from this machine because the only tokens available are either fully authorised or invalid. The tool branches on gh's non-zero exit status, which 401 and 403 share, and never on the code, so this envelope drives the same path. Recorded honestly rather than edited into a 403.
